## Statute

§152(c)(2)(A) at line 138:
"(A) a child of the taxpayer or a descendant of such a child, or"

§152(c)(2)(B) at line 140:
"(B) a brother, sister, stepbrother, or stepsister of the taxpayer or a descendant of any such relative."

## Reasoning

The case facts state that Bob is Alice's brother (born January 31st, 2014).

Section 152(c)(2)(A) defines a qualifying relationship as: "a child of the taxpayer or a descendant of such a child."

Section 152(c)(2)(B) defines a qualifying relationship as: "a brother, sister, stepbrother, or stepsister of the taxpayer or a descendant of any such relative."

Bob bears a relationship to Alice as her brother. This relationship falls under section 152(c)(2)(B), not section 152(c)(2)(A).

The claim states "Bob bears a relationship to Alice under section 152(c)(2)(A)." Since Bob is Alice's brother (not her child or descendant of her child), this claim is false.

## Answer
Answer: Contradiction
